chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: An archive for his DeLisa music
summary: DeMichael mentions the Institute's archive; Saunders would go through his DeLisa music book with someone and donate items.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: I know the Institute wants to establish an archive here, for historical documents.
Well, that would be beautiful. Well, those things, I would only too happy to, because, like, the Institute and the museum -- what do call it, the New Orleans --

Jazz Museum and stuff, when we were with Art Hodes, down there, I put a pair of sticks in there. But I would like to -- I go through this music, or we could get somebody to go with me through it, because I have the book from the old Delisa and all those things, and we could go through there

and maybe we could pick out some things. Because every once in a while, man, if I really want to get nostalgic, I go there and look through this music, man, and this music brings back all of the things.
